recordText: From about 1300, first a mechanical device, especially for war, but also skill, cleverness, even trickery. Old French *engin*, from Latin *ingenium*, "inborn character." The sense of a machine that turns energy into motion arrives in the 1700s.
gossipText: Was born a talent and became a machine. Still describes himself as "a natural gift." Nobody has the heart to correct him.
testimony: I ran the mechanism. Latin well-born, to Old French dainty, to more dainty, to Gingerly. It works on paper. Nobody has ever found the parts.
